title: A conformational energy landscape
caption: Rotating bonds in a flexible molecule moves it across an energy landscape with several minima (stable conformers) separated by barriers. A conformational search aims to find the global minimum, not just the nearest local one. Illustrative one-dimensional slice.
alt: Energy against a conformational coordinate: a wavy curve with several local minima, the lowest near 2.85.
description: Several dips: local minima, each a stable conformer.
Hills between them: barriers to interconversion.
The deepest dip: the global minimum.

checks.name: the deepest minimum (global) is at 2.85, not the first one reached from either end
